_provenance: Real Twitch PRIVMSG SSE frame captured from a live desktop Chrome repro, 2026-09-03. Server-side gif_host_accepted logged this exact url as accepted, but the PWA rendered zero , no console error. Root cause: esbuild's production bundle (wrangler deploy, minified — unlike wrangler dev / plain vitest imports) wraps a locally-scoped named closure (renderGifToken's old `buildImg` helper) in its `__name()` runtime helper; that call is baked into the closure's Function.prototype.toString() text, which is then re-embedded client-side via ${renderGifToken} template interpolation into a script where __name is never defined -- ReferenceError, silently swallowed by socket.onmessage's empty catch. See test/bundle-gif-render.test.js.
